description_en: Queries the information about real-time materialized views of an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 查询AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的实时物化视图详情
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-imv-infos --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxxx --database testdb --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeIMVInfos

DBInstanceId.description_en:
The ID of the instance.

You can call the [DescribeDBInstances]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html） operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including instance IDs

ImvInfos.description_zh: 视图关系信息的对象数组

Base.description_en: The name of the table based on which the materialized view is created

DetailInfo.description_en: The dependency between the materialized view and the base table and all metric values, which can be used to build a lineage graph
